title: feat(desktop): Prepare screen two-column layout (NIW2-583)
body:
## What

Rebuilds the Prepare page (`/prepare/:assetId`, from #448) to the owner's design: **two columns**, with no page scroll at the window size the app opens at.

- **Left (280–330 px)**: ← Back to recording · **Post · they re-compress it · send more** (pink): YouTube, Reels · TikTok · Shorts, LinkedIn · Feeds · **Send · they play it as-is · keep it light** (teal): GitHub · Jira · Linear, Slack · Discord · Email · **Keep · a full-quality copy**: Archive copy. Each row shows its logo tile, name, one-line hint and size (amber when bigger, grey otherwise, **✓ Ready** when a copy already exists). The selected row has a pink tint and a pink border. **Prepare another video** is pinned to the bottom and opens the Library.
- **Right**: big tile + **For YouTube** + "From your recording · 3:02 · 1916 × 1048 · 119 MB". Below that:
  - a **What changes** card (Size original → estimate in amber/teal, Picture W×H → W×H, Smoothness only when capped, Sound, Length "· nothing cut");
  - the **Why it gets bigger** (pink) / **Why it gets lighter** (teal) card beside it;
  - the destination's one choice: YouTube **Upload size** 1440p / 4K + the before/after text crop; the GitHub / chat size bar with "N% lighter · under the 10 MB limit"; Fill / Fit for vertical and square;
  - **Prepare for YouTube · up to ~570 MB ↵**, with "Runs in the background. We'll tell you when it's ready. Your original stays as it is."
- **A destination is always selected**: `?to=`, otherwise YouTube. The right panel is never empty.
- **Enter** runs the primary button from anywhere on the page, including a focused destination row or the 1440p / 4K control. It does not fire in a text field, with a modifier held, or on another button or link.

## Why

During QA of #448 the owner found three problems: the three-column layout overflowed (the right column scrolled at the default window size), "Back to recording" sat in the wrong place, and the right panel was empty ("Pick where it's going") until a destination was picked. NIW2-583 asks for the design's layout.

## Decisions

- **Sized for 900 × 670.** `createWindow` opens the main window at 900 × 670. That is the `main` preset's minimum, and the first screen does not resize it. The page gets 828 × 614 below the status bar. I budgeted both columns for that size, with room for the unexported-edits note. Below it each column scrolls on its own, never the page. The page drops the shell's 24 px padding (edge to edge, like the design).
- **Default destination: YouTube, not the last one used.** A remembered choice from another recording would make the same link open differently from day to day. `?to=` still wins, and an unknown `?to=` also falls back to YouTube.
- **"up to" sits above the number in the list.** YouTube, vertical and square estimates are a bitrate ceiling. "~570 MB" alone would overstate the typical size. The full "up to ~570 MB" did not fit the row without truncating names.
- **The text crop is an illustration, and labelled as one.** The design says "your own text, not a sample". The app has no full-resolution frame to crop, and blurring the 160 px thumbnail would pretend to show YouTube's output. It is drawn text ("npm run build") with the caption "An illustration of what YouTube's own compression does to small text." A real frame crop is a follow-up.
- **"Prepare another video" says "Pick one from your Library"**, not "Drop a file here". Dropping a file is NIW2-587. Until then, the design's copy would promise something the page does not do.
- **No time estimate** next to the button: there is no honest number for it.
- **Removed from the page**: the "Original" column (its facts are in the header line), "Already prepared" (replaced by ✓ Ready on each row), the folded "What changes in the copy" (now an always-visible card), and the GitHub plan chips (the bar states the free-plan fit; the Ready card keeps the chips). Their `prepare.*` i18n keys stay for now so sibling branches merge cleanly. They can be pruned after those branches land.
- **Destination model unchanged.** `destinations.ts` / `destination-copy.ts` keep their public API. The new i18n keys are one contiguous block inside `prepare` in both locales (neutral Spanish).

Files: `pages/prepare/prepare-page.tsx` (container, selection, Enter), `destination-list.tsx` (left column), `destination-detail.tsx` (right column), each with its own CSS module. Backlog doc updated.

## Verification

- `bun run verify` passes from the repo root: workflows, lint, format, build, types, and all tests (kaipu-record 3006).
- `prepare-page.test.tsx` (18 tests) covers: YouTube as the default, `?to=`, the unknown `?to=` fallback, What changes values, "up to" in the row, why-card titles, 1440p/4K, Enter from the body and from a row (no re-select), Enter ignored in a field / with a modifier / on Back, the GitHub size bar over and under 10 MB, Fill/Fit, Archive, busy, unreadable, screenshot, Ready → Open the copy you have (also via Enter), the edits note, Prepare another video, and Back.
- **Not run:** Electron. No runtime or visual check. The no-scroll claim is a layout budget, not a measurement. It needs the owner's QA below.

Linear: [NIW2-583](https://linear.app/niway/issue/NIW2-583/prepare-screen-two-column-layout-from-the-design-no-scroll-enter) · Design: [Kaipu Prepare.dc.html, section 3](https://claude.ai/design/p/71546ef1-baf5-42e9-8fcc-9b9b44f2c7ab?file=Kaipu+Prepare.dc.html) · Stacked on #448 (https://github.com/niway-dev/kaipu-record/pull/448).

## How to test it yourself

1. Check out `feature/niw2-583-prepare-two-column`, then `bun install` and `bun run dev`.
2. Quit and reopen the app so the window is at its default size (900 × 670). Don't resize it.
3. Open a recording in the Library → **Prepare for…**. Expect two columns, **YouTube** selected (pink row), and "For YouTube" with the recording's duration, size and file size. **No scrollbar** on the page or in either column.
4. Shrink the window to its minimum. Each column may scroll on its own; the whole page must not.
5. With YouTube selected, check: What changes shows Size in amber ("119 MB → up to ~… MB") and Picture "… → 2560 × 1440"; "Why it gets bigger" is pink. Click **4K**: the sizes and "With this copy · 4K" update.
6. Press **Enter** without clicking anything. Prepare starts, you land back on the recording, and the progress card appears.
7. Open Prepare again, click **GitHub · Jira · Linear**, then press **Enter** while that row is focused. It should prepare the GitHub copy and not just re-select the row. Before pressing, check the bar: "~… MB · N% lighter · under the 10 MB limit" on a short clip, "over GitHub's 10 MB free-plan limit" on a long one, and "Why it gets lighter" in teal.
8. Click **Reels · TikTok · Shorts**: Fill / Fit with the preview. Click **Archive copy**: no choice card, button "Prepare for Archive copy".
9. After a copy finishes, reopen Prepare. Its row reads **✓ Ready**, and the button reads **Open the copy you have ↵**, with **Prepare again** next to it.
10. Click **Prepare another video** → the Library. Click **← Back to recording** → the recording.
11. Switch the app to Spanish and repeat step 3: the labels fit and nothing overflows.
